official.deadline_note: Fudan published two windows for this scheme: 2025.10.13-2025.12.12 (Phase One, the window in which the scholarship application must be submitted) and 2026.03.01-2026.03.15. The CSC Campus China scholarship application itself had to be completed before 25 March 2026. All dates are Beijing Time.
official.status_note: Both published application windows of the 2026 cycle have ended (12 December 2025 and 15 March 2026). Fudan's ISO notices column now carries 2026 autumn registration and 2026 scholarship annual-review items, and no further round for this scheme is currently open.
official.tuition_coverage_note: "Exemption from tuition fee about one year, providing free on-campus accommodation or providing accommodation subsidy, Comprehensive Medical Insurance"
benefits: Exemption from tuition fee about one year
providing free on-campus accommodation or providing accommodation subsidy
eligibility: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens, under the age of 45 and in good health.
Applicants should hold bachelor's degree or above and work experience of three years or above. Applicants with professional study or work background related to the applied project are preferred.

Applicants should be one of the following four categories: public officials at the division level (or corresponding level) of the government department in the host country or above; senior managers of institutions and enterprises; administrative personnel of universities and scientific research institutions; personnel with relevant experience in international organizations or internships.
Applicants should not be holding any other scholarship provided by Chinese government.
Passport must be an ordinary one and valid date should after March 1, 2027.
requirements: Register at https://istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply, choose program 'FLS LL.M. Program in Chinese Business Law' or 'Master Program of Public Management' as self-support student and fill in the application form.
Please pay application fee online (800 RMB). The application fee will not be returned.
Language certificate and score report (TOEFL-above 90, IELTS-above 6.5, etc.).
Two recommendation letters; the referee must be professor or associate professor and the letter should be in Chinese or English and include the referee's signature.
Personal statement should be written in Chinese and should include study and work experience, academic achievement, expected research proposal, and career plan after graduation.
Proof of No Criminal Record in Chinese or English, plus Proof of Financial Capacity or Fudan's Statement of Financial Support for International Students.
documents: Photocopy of valid passport identification page - ordinary passport valid after 1 March 2027, plus the visa or residence permit page for applicants currently residing in China.

Diploma of the highest degree conferred or proof of impending graduation (final-year applicants), original or notarised copy, with notarised Chinese or English translation if the original is not in Chinese or English.
Transcripts of the highest degree conferred, original or notarised copy, with notarised Chinese or English translation if needed.
Two recommendation letters in Chinese or English, signed by a professor or associate professor.
Personal statement written in Chinese (study and work experience, academic achievement, expected research proposal, career plan).

Language certificate and score report, Proof of No Criminal Record, Proof of Financial Capacity or Fudan's Statement of Financial Support, and the Foreigner Physical Examination Form (valid six months).

One of the four identity certificates (division-level public official, senior manager of institutions or enterprises, administrative personnel of universities or research institutions, personnel with international organization experience or internships), merged with the pre-admission letter into a single PDF for the CSC scholarship application system.
selection_criteria: After applicants' documents being approved by university, we would issue a pre-admission letter to applicants - pre-admission from Fudan is a precondition of the scholarship application.
The Chinese Scholarship Council will decide whether to award the scholarship or not.
Applicants must evidence membership of one of the four eligible professional categories when applying on the CSC website.
Applicants who have not won scholarships can choose to study as self-support student.
coverage: Exemption from tuition fee about one year
Free on-campus accommodation or an accommodation subsidy
Living stipend: Master student 3000RMB/month, Doctoral student 3500RMB/month
application_method: Register at https://istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply, choose 'FLS LL.M. Program in Chinese Business Law' or 'Master Program of Public Management' as self-support student, upload the required digital application documents and complete the online application.
Pay the application fee online (800 RMB); it is non-refundable.

Email fudanllm@fudan.edu.cn (FLS LL.M. applicants) or igppadmin@fudan.edu.cn (Master Program of Public Management applicants), carbon copy cym@fudan.edu.cn, stating willingness to apply for the Youth of Excellence Scheme and giving the Fudan application number beginning with C20260902.
After document approval, Fudan issues a pre-admission letter to the applicant.

Apply on the CSC website http://www.campuschina.org before 25 March 2026 choosing Program Category Type A, Agency No.1563, program 'Youth of Excellence Scheme of China Program Chinese Government Scholarship Program', Major Civil Law or Public Management, Teaching Language English.
official.application_route: Two-stage: apply through Fudan's istudent portal on the self-funded route, pay the RMB 800 fee, email the programme office to declare scholarship intent, obtain Fudan pre-admission, then submit the Type A (Agency No. 1563) application on the CSC Campus China portal.
official.citizenship_residency: Non-Chinese citizens in good health. Whether an applicant holding foreign nationality also holds PRC nationality is subject to the nationality determination of the Exit-entry Administration Bureau of China; if recognised as Chinese after application or enrolment, the application qualification, admission eligibility or enrolment status is cancelled.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scheme is for non-Chinese international applicants and all three host programmes at Fudan are English-taught.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Restricted to two Fudan offerings: the FLS LL.M. Program in Chinese Business Law and the Master Program of Public Management (Master in Global Public Policy and International Master of Public Administration). On the CSC portal the available majors are Civil Law or Public Management.
official.research_requirement: The personal statement must include an expected research proposal. Both host public-management programmes require a defended master's thesis of at least 20,000 words; the FLS LL.M. requires a 12,000-15,000 English-word dissertation completed and submitted by 20 February of the second year.
official.duration: FLS LL.M. Program in Chinese Business Law: two years (one year coursework plus one year dissertation). Master Program of Public Management (MGPP and IMPA): two years full-time, accomplishable in 2-5 years.
official.description: Fudan presents the scheme as cultivating global governance talents with broad international vision, excellent comprehensive quality, excellent leadership and cross-cultural background, specifically implemented by the Management Committee of the China Scholarship Council, and funds only three named English-taught master's programmes on its Handan Road campus in Shanghai.
official.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship - Youth of Excellence Scheme of China Program (government-funded master's degree)
official.english_requirement: TOEFL (IBT) score of 90 or above / IELTS score of 6.5 or above, or the equivalent of another standardised English test such as the Cambridge English exam; applicants scoring below or who have not taken an English language exam may be requested to attend an interview with the admissions staff to obtain a waiver.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a mid-career scheme rather than a fresh-graduate one: Fudan offers it only on the FLS LL.M. in Chinese Business Law and the Master Program of Public Management (MGPP and IMPA), and you must already hold a bachelor's degree with three or more years of work experience plus a qualifying senior role. The money is real but bounded - a CNY 3,000 monthly stipend, tuition exemption for about one year, campus accommodation or a housing subsidy, and comprehensive medical insurance, against published self-funded tuition of CNY 100,000-120,000 per year for the public-management programmes and CNY 240,000 total for the two-year LL.M. Because the award is decided by the China Scholarship Council only after Fudan issues a pre-admission letter, the practical order of operations is to apply to Fudan first on the self-funded route, then file the Type A (Agency No. 1563) application on the CSC Campus China portal.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mid-career government officials at division level or above, senior managers, university administrators and international-organization staff with three or more years' experience who want an English-taught master's in Chinese business law or public policy in Shanghai.
application_readiness_checklist: Check the passport immediately: it must be an ordinary passport valid beyond 1 March 2027, which rules out anything expiring during 2026.
Diarise the 13 October - 12 December Phase One window, because the scholarship application has to be submitted in that window rather than in the March top-up.
Brief two referees who are professors or associate professors at least two weeks early - the portal recommendation link must be completed within 15 days and no later than the deadline.
Draft the personal statement in Chinese and build in the expected research proposal section, which this scheme explicitly asks for even though the teaching language is English.
Arrange the Foreigner Physical Examination Form ahead of time: it needs blood work, a chest X-ray report and an ECG with the examining unit's official stamp, and is valid for six months only.
Obtain an employer-issued identity certificate for one of the four categories, ready to merge with the pre-admission letter into a single PDF for the CSC portal.
common_rejection_risks: Filing the scholarship bid in the March window, which Fudan reserved for self-funded applications - a late scholarship submission simply loses the round.
Applying to any Fudan programme outside the three named ones, or selecting the wrong CSC major (Civil Law or Public Management are the only options).

Stopping at Fudan pre-admission and never completing the Type A, Agency No. 1563 application on Campus China, or uploading the identity certificate and pre-admission letter as two separate files instead of one merged PDF.
Holding another Chinese government scholarship, which is an outright bar, or concealing financial support, which bars re-application for three years.
Documents arriving without notarised Chinese or English translations, or recommendation letters from a referee who is not a professor or associate professor.
Assuming the award follows automatically from admission: the CSC decides separately, and unsuccessful applicants are simply enrolled as self-support students.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The non-refundable RMB 800 application fee; tuition beyond the 'about one year' exemption (roughly CNY 100,000-120,000 per year for MGPP/IMPA and CNY 240,000 total for the two-year LL.M.); return airfare and airport transfers, which are not part of the published package; visa and residence-permit costs; living costs above the CNY 3,000 monthly stipend; and accommodation costs if the free on-campus room is declined, since only a subsidy is offered instead.
document_audit: The Foreigner Physical Examination Form must be physician-completed and carry the examining unit's stamp, with the blood test and chest X-ray report attached - a six-month-old report expires mid-cycle.
Applicants already residing in China may substitute a Residence Permit or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card for the physical examination form, but not for any other document.
Degrees and transcripts require notarisation plus a notarised Chinese or English translation whenever the original language is neither, so start notarisation before the window opens.
The CSC portal requires the identity certificate and the pre-admission letter combined into one PDF in the pre-admission letter column.
The personal statement must be written in Chinese despite English-taught teaching - the single most common trap for applicants who assume an all-English file.
alerts: The tuition exemption is published as 'about one year' on programmes that run two years, so budget for second-year tuition even if awarded.
All dates are Beijing Time and Fudan warns the admission information may be updated at any time - re-read the ISO Notices column before each stage.

Scholarship holders cannot change major or study period, must pass an annual evaluation, and combining the CGS with other Chinese government or university funding cancels the award and requires repayment.
Both 2026 windows had already passed at verification, so the next realistic opportunity is the following year's October-December Phase One; Fudan had not published 2027 dates.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fudan istudent portal on the self-funded route (RMB 800 fee, document upload) -> email the programme office declaring scholarship intent with your C2026xxxx application number -> wait for the Fudan pre-admission letter -> Type A, Agency No. 1563 application on the CSC Campus China portal by 25 March 2026 with identity certificate and pre-admission letter merged into one PDF -> CSC decision.
